title: Release gate and CI fail when the npm registry is degraded: the live production-audit test has no offline path and hides the payload
observation: test/production-dependency-audit.test.ts runs a live `npm audit --omit=dev --json` inside the full suite. During npm's scheduled maintenance (2026-09-19 17:00-19:00Z) the registry answered with JSON that is not an auditReportVersion 2 report, so the test failed in ~770 ms with 'npm audit returned an unsupported or malformed JSON report' on three runs in the same window: main CI for the v1.39.3 release merge f909958e, PR #356's rerun, and the tagged Release workflow (validate failed, publish skipped). The same audit run locally at 17:40Z on f909958e returned a clean, well-formed report (0 vulnerabilities). evaluateProductionAudit throws without printing the payload it rejected, so the CI log cannot distinguish a registry error object from a real format change. The hunch-agent App cannot rerun workflows (actions: 'Resource not accessible by integration'), so recovery needs a human click.
